packet_dag.terminal_condition: Parent/student entry UI is not done until current-state evidence, implementation, tests, deploy, and live smoke pass.

title: Parent And Student Login UI Polish

reasons: Operator explicitly said the student login and parent login look terrible and unprofessional.
Operator named uneven spacing and inconsistent layout as the visible defect.
Operator asked for Agent Mode prompts and for Codex to keep fixing the UI.
Parent/student surfaces are role-sensitive and require scope/privacy checks before app-visible completion.
affected_product_surfaces: Student login shell and student review entry
Parent/member login shell and parent review entry
Cross-role entry consistency between Operations view-as, provider/Rabbi, parent/member, and student views
likely_external_provider_blockers: No external email, payment, access grant, DNS, credential, or provider account write is needed or approved.
Any real parent/student account mutation remains out of scope for this UI polish pass.
App-visible completion requires deploy and live smoke after commit/push.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Run current-state parent/student entry visual audit at desktop and mobile before editing UI.

operator_intent_summary: Shloimie wants the student and parent login/entry surfaces to stop looking uneven, unprofessional, and poorly spaced. The immediate outcome is navigation-first Agent Mode audit prompts plus a scoped Codex visual audit and implementation pass.
raw_quotes: The parent login, it looks unprofessional.
make sure that they're dropping it off in the right section
give me some agent mode prompts
Keep fixing stuff. Let's fix up this UI so it works.

decisions_captured.decision: Run Agent Mode audits in parallel as audit-only prompts and let Codex implement from recovered drop-off reports plus local visual evidence.

out_of_scope: No full-app redesign in this packet.
No live email, payment, access grant, DNS, credential, provider account, or production data mutation.
No real impersonation through shared passwords.
No staging or reverting unrelated dirty work.
No claiming completion without desktop/mobile visual evidence and live smoke.
affected_surfaces: Student login and student preview entry
Parent/member login and parent preview entry
Cross-role entry consistency between Student, Parent/Member, Provider/Rabbi, and Operations view-as

inspection_targets: Student review entry at desktop 1440 and mobile 390
Student login shell at desktop 1440 and mobile 390
Parent login shell at desktop 1440 and mobile 390
Parent review entry at desktop 1440 and mobile 390
Buttons, cards, form controls, spacing, headings, status labels, and role-scope copy
known_from_operator: Spacing and alignment are visibly uneven.
known_blockers: Implementation is blocked until current-state visual evidence is captured.
Agent Mode reports may still fail drop-off and must report the failure explicitly.

expanded_phrases.terrible: Visible UI has obvious product-quality defects that a non-technical user can notice immediately.
expanded_phrases.unprofessional: The entry screen lacks consistent hierarchy, spacing, button treatment, and confidence-building role context.
expanded_phrases.not even: Buttons, cards, inputs, and columns do not align to a consistent grid or equal-height control model.
expanded_phrases.not spaced out well: Vertical and horizontal spacing is inconsistent, wasteful, cramped, or poorly grouped across desktop/mobile.
expanded_phrases.ridiculous: The screen is not acceptable for a production-facing parent/student portal and needs evidence-backed repair.
expanded_phrases.clean: The screen has a simple hierarchy, no duplicated action rows, no debug clutter, and clear primary/secondary action grouping.
expanded_phrases.professional: The screen uses consistent typography, alignment, spacing, card/form hierarchy, role labels, and responsive behavior suitable for a parent or student-facing production portal.

requirements.statement: Compile and validate the parent/student login UI polish packet.
requirements.expected_result: The vague UI complaint becomes exact routes, states, visual criteria, audit prompts, tests, evidence paths, and release gates.
acceptance_criteria: Agent Mode prompts specify exact routes and drop-off coordinates.

requirements.statement: Repair parent/student entry UI spacing, alignment, and mobile professionalism after current-state audit.
requirements.expected_result: Parent/student entry surfaces look consistent, role-clear, responsive, and production-ready at desktop and mobile widths.
acceptance_criteria: Buttons have consistent height and logical grouping.
Cards/forms align to a clean grid and avoid awkward empty space.
Mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow, clipping, or overlapping text.
Parent/student role scope is explicit and no admin/provider private data appears.
Focused tests and live smoke pass.

criteria: Current-state screenshots and findings exist before UI edits.
No external writes or credential decisions are needed.

loading.how_to_enter_state: Open the student review route directly in a desktop browser.
loading.expected_visible_message: Student entry loads without layout jump, overlapping cards, or hidden role context.
loading.aria_semantic_expectation: The student role and main action are announced in heading and button order.
loading.accessibility_expectation: Loading content settles without focus jump or inaccessible hidden controls.
loading.test_smoke_assertion: Student review entry renders with no overlap, no horizontal overflow, and a visible role label.

empty.how_to_enter_state: Open the public student login route without a student session.
empty.expected_visible_message: Access-code or login state is clear, centered, and not visually stranded.
empty.aria_semantic_expectation: The login form fields and continue action have readable labels.
empty.accessibility_expectation: The login shell remains keyboard reachable and does not depend on placeholder-only labels.
empty.test_smoke_assertion: Student login shell has a clear action and no stale private data.

populated.how_to_enter_state: Open the parent/member review route directly in a desktop browser.
populated.expected_visible_message: Parent/member entry uses balanced hierarchy, aligned actions, and clear preview role context.
populated.aria_semantic_expectation: The parent/member role context is visible near the main heading and primary action.
populated.accessibility_expectation: Cards and actions follow a logical reading order.
populated.test_smoke_assertion: Parent/member entry has aligned actions and no role-scope leakage.

filtered_empty.how_to_enter_state: Open the parent/member review route at tablet width and inspect any empty preview sections.
filtered_empty.expected_visible_message: Any empty/preview section gives a clear reason and recovery action.
filtered_empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Empty or filtered-empty text is associated with the relevant section heading.
filtered_empty.accessibility_expectation: Recovery controls remain reachable without pointer-only interaction.
filtered_empty.test_smoke_assertion: No empty state appears as a broken blank card or wasted first viewport.

error.how_to_enter_state: Open student login on mobile and trigger or inspect the visible error/invalid state if available.
error.expected_visible_message: Invalid or unavailable login state explains what happened without cramped text.
error.aria_semantic_expectation: Error text is announced or located directly beside the affected form/action.
error.accessibility_expectation: Error text wraps cleanly and does not occlude the retry action.
error.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile login error state has no clipped labels, overflow, or secret-like text.

blocked_setup.how_to_enter_state: Open parent/member review on narrow mobile and inspect any login-required or setup-blocked message.
blocked_setup.expected_visible_message: Preview/login-required state is clear and does not look broken.
blocked_setup.aria_semantic_expectation: Blocked/setup message is tied to the disabled or unavailable action.
blocked_setup.accessibility_expectation: Disabled or blocked controls explain their reason in visible text.
blocked_setup.test_smoke_assertion: Blocked parent/member state is clear and has no live-send/payment controls.

preview_only.how_to_enter_state: Open student review route on narrow mobile and inspect preview-only controls.
preview_only.expected_visible_message: Preview-only status is visible and the student-facing controls are child-safe.
preview_only.aria_semantic_expectation: Preview-only status is discoverable before interactive student actions.
preview_only.accessibility_expectation: Student actions remain tappable and clearly labelled at 430px.
preview_only.test_smoke_assertion: Student preview mode shows no live post, cross-student data, or admin controls.

success_readback.how_to_enter_state: Open parent/member review route on 390px mobile after successful load/readback.
success_readback.expected_visible_message: Entry page shows a successful preview/readback state without overflow.
success_readback.aria_semantic_expectation: Success/readback status is readable without disrupting focus order.
success_readback.accessibility_expectation: Primary and secondary actions remain at least 44px tall.
success_readback.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile parent/member entry has no horizontal scroll, overlap, or clipped action labels.

permission_denied.how_to_enter_state: Open student login with wrong-scope or stale-session conditions if present, otherwise inspect logged-out denial/recovery state.
permission_denied.expected_visible_message: Wrong or stale access is cleared or rejected with a clear recovery action.
permission_denied.aria_semantic_expectation: Permission denial or session-clear message is visible near recovery actions.
permission_denied.accessibility_expectation: Recovery controls can be reached by keyboard and touch.
permission_denied.test_smoke_assertion: Wrong-scope student login state exposes no private student, parent, or admin data.

mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.how_to_enter_state: Open the parent/member entry route on mobile and inspect the detail/action area.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.expected_visible_message: Mobile detail/entry state fits in the viewport with tappable actions.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.aria_semantic_expectation: Mobile detail/entry controls have clear accessible names and close/return path.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.accessibility_expectation: Controls fit within viewport, wrap predictably, and remain tappable.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile detail state renders without clipped text, overlapping controls, or horizontal overflow.

requirements: Buttons remain at least 44px tall on mobile.
Input labels and role labels are visible and programmatically discoverable.
Error and blocked states provide clear recovery actions.
Text does not clip or overlap at 390px.
verification: Playwright DOM measurements for overflow and button height.
Manual screenshot review for spacing and hierarchy.

action_states.handler_or_blocker: Existing student login/access-code handler or explicit blocked/login-required UI state

forbidden_fields: parent contact fields in student scope

role_scope_invariants: Student scope cannot expose parent contact fields, admin controls, provider data, or cross-student private data.
Parent/member scope can show only approved parent/member-visible preview data.
Review routes must remain preview/read-only unless a real authenticated session is intentionally present.
security_privacy.secret_handling: No cookies, session IDs, access codes, raw private bodies, or secret-shaped values may be committed in screenshots or reports.
